title: RentGuard Renters Policy Coverage Schedule — Limits, Settlement and Deductibles
content:
The RentGuard Renters Policy insures the tenant's personal property (Coverage C), the tenant's additional living expense after a covered loss (Coverage D, loss of use), personal liability and medical payments to others. Each of the six HO-4 tiers fixes its own range and options for these coverages. All amounts are in USD.

## Coverage C — personal property

| Tier | Lowest Coverage C limit | Highest Coverage C limit | Loss settlement basis | Peril basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 15000 | 30000 | actual cash value | named perils |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 20000 | 50000 | actual cash value | named perils |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 25000 | 75000 | replacement cost | named perils |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 30000 | 100000 | replacement cost | named perils |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 40000 | 150000 | replacement cost | open perils |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 60000 | 250000 | replacement cost | open perils |

## Coverage D — loss of use

Loss of use is stated as a percent of the policy's Coverage C limit, and additional living expense is paid for no longer than the tier's longest period.

| Tier | Loss of use (percent of Coverage C) | Longest period paid (months) |
|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 20 | 12 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 20 | 12 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 30 | 12 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 30 | 12 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 30 | 24 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 40 | 24 |

## Liability, medical payments and deductibles

| Tier | Personal liability limits available | Medical payments to others, per person | Deductibles available |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 100000 | 1000 | 500, 1000 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 100000 or 300000 | 1000 | 500, 1000 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 100000 or 300000 | 2500 | 250, 500, 1000 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 300000 or 500000 | 2500 | 250, 500, 1000 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 300000 or 500000 | 5000 | 250, 500, 1000 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 500000 or 1000000 | 5000 | 100, 250, 500, 1000 |

## Reading the schedule

- A liability limit or deductible not listed in a tier's row is not available on that tier; HO-4 Starter, for example, carries only the 100000 liability limit.
- Actual cash value settlement applies on HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential; the four higher tiers settle contents on replacement cost.
- Open-perils Coverage C is found only on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.

**Hypothetical example.** A RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced policy written with a Coverage C limit of 40000 carries loss of use of 30 percent of that limit, which is 12000, payable for no longer than 12 months.
